parsed.notes:
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR is the requirements section; no heading marks an optional section.
Read literally, 'useful' is not one of the guide's enumerated inline optional markers, so Python and evaluation frameworks remain required; flagged for review because the wording suggests optionality.
Agent orchestration and context management are left unmapped rather than equated with LLM orchestration or agent state management without an explicit taxonomy match.
Inference infrastructure is mapped to AI Infrastructure in the explicit AI/LLM context; the 'or' alternatives remain separately requested skills.
Procurement experience is domain knowledge, and helping engineers succeed and making sound technical decisions are not labeled as technical skills.
Technologies and practices mentioned only under WHAT YOU'LL DO are excluded. Berlin does not establish a German-language requirement.
